_meta.indication: MEKTOVI, in combination with encorafenib, is indicated for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with a BRAF V600E or V600K mutation, as detected by an FDA-approved test.

pivotal_trials.design: Open-label, randomized, multicenter, two-part study; Part 1 randomized 1:1:1 to Combo 450 (encorafenib 450 mg daily plus binimetinib 45 mg twice daily), encorafenib 300 mg daily alone, or vemurafenib 960 mg twice daily.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with locally advanced, unresectable or metastatic cutaneous melanoma (AJCC Stage IIIB, IIIC or IV) harboring a BRAF V600E and/or V600K mutation.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint was progression-free survival (PFS) by RECIST v1.1 per blinded independent central review, Combo 450 vs vemurafenib.
pivotal_trials.n: Part 1: 577 patients randomized (192 Combo 450, 194 encorafenib, 191 vemurafenib).
pivotal_trials.result: Median PFS 14.9 months for Combo 450 vs 7.3 months for vemurafenib (HR 0.54, 95% CI 0.41, 0.71; p<0.0001).

nct_ctgov.title: Study Comparing Combination of LGX818 Plus MEK162 Versus Vemurafenib and LGX818 Monotherapy in BRAF Mutant Melanoma

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥25%) with MEKTOVI plus encorafenib were fatigue (43%), nausea (41%), diarrhea (36%), vomiting (30%), and abdominal pain (28%). Important serious toxicities include ocular toxicities (serious retinopathy, retinal vein occlusion, uveitis), cardiomyopathy/left ventricular dysfunction, hemorrhage, QT prolongation, venous thromboembolism, interstitial lung disease, hepatotoxicity, and rhabdomyolysis.
target_moa: Binimetinib is an orally bioavailable, slowly-reversible inhibitor of MEK1 and MEK2 kinases (IC50 ~12 and 46 nM respectively), blocking the MAP kinase pathway that is constitutively activated by BRAF V600 mutations in melanoma.
companion_dx_detail: A device to select patients (detection of BRAF V600E/V600K mutation) is required; in COLUMBUS patients were selected using the bioMerieux THxID BRAF assay, and an FDA-approved test is required per the label.

advisory_committee.vote: The application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because this is not the first drug in its class and no novel issues were identified.

description.text: Added new indication: binimetinib in combination with encorafenib for adult patients with metastatic NSCLC with BRAF V600E mutation

description.text: Labeling update with mature overall survival data from COLUMBUS trial and added photosensitivity adverse reaction; no new indication (PMC fulfillment)

summary.text: MEKTOVI (binimetinib), in combination with encorafenib, received regular (full) approval under standard review based on a statistically significant PFS advantage in the COLUMBUS trial; the product carries an orphan drug designation. The application was not referred to an advisory committee.
